name: thread-fingerprint
description: Privacy-minimized read-only utility for identifying a ChatGPT conversation.

interface.shortDescription: Identify the current conversation without exposing its raw ID.
interface.longDescription: Creates a deterministic one-way fingerprint from ChatGPT's anonymized conversation metadata. It does not return raw identifiers, inspect conversation content, or persist observations.
defaultPrompt: Verify whether this is the same conversation.
